fields.statement: At 933178f7: go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(daemon-version-in-health|describe-golden)$' -count=1 passes; make fmt-check vet test exits 0. The scenario starts a daemon with RHIZA_TEST_COMMIT set to the built commit; daemon status prints 'Commit: <40-hex>' and --json carries "commit". With origin/main at that commit, health's daemon part is ok; after an extra commit moved origin/main ahead, it is warn: '...; built from <built7>, origin/main is at <head7>'. I re-ran a temporary copy of the scenario that printed health --json (deleted afterwards): the daemon part was state "ok" when the commits matched, and state "warn", summary 'built from a10ad21, origin/main is at 4919c15', next "make update" when origin/main was ahead. Diff read: Commit comes from the build info's vcs.revision (RHIZA_TEST_COMMIT only under RHIZA_TEST_NOW), is stored in daemon.State and DaemonStatusResponse, and healthOriginAhead warns only when origin/main is a strict descendant (merge-base --is-ancestor), with no fetch. make self-check's only failures were rendered actor files for actors registered after this commit (including this verifier), so not caused by the leaf.
